complete_case_comparison_limitations: Public cross-sectional observations cannot identify latent state or transition rates.
Adult, noninstitutionalized survey population and 2017-March 2020 period do not directly initialize every age of the 2024 engine population.
Public age top-coding prevents single-age decomposition in the oldest group; no pediatric interpolation is performed.
Known diagnoses retain precedence within complete cases; incomplete records can remain unclassified despite known diabetes.
Treatment use, control duration, diabetes type, all chronic diseases and confirmed remission are not identified.
PreChronic alternatives and overlapping age domains share observations and must not be summed.
No active model parameter or numerical engine output changes.

denominator: All eligible weight in each age/sex domain, including unclassified records
limitations: Bounds concern the registered observation categories, not true latent health states.
Any-type diabetes does not identify T2D; normoglycemia does not identify general metabolic health.
Adult survey observations from 2017-March 2020 do not resolve pediatric, oldest-age, institutionalized or current-year population transport. Survey-selection and diagnostic errors remain unresolved.
A single high laboratory measurement is an observation category, not a confirmed clinical diagnosis.
Partially observed blood-pressure blocks are coarsened; bounds need not be sharp over raw completions.
Known diabetes takes priority despite unrelated missing measurements in this alternative; the original complete-case report remains available separately.
Unknown values remain sets of possible categories; no imputation or automatic engine allocation.
population: U.S. noninstitutionalized adults in the positive-weight NHANES 2017-March 2020 fasting subsample, excluding known pregnancy within the public age window

crosswalk.reason: Normal glycemia does not identify overall metabolic health or absence of other disease.
The glycemic threshold category does not identify all insulin resistance.
Diabetes type is not identified; no subtraction or assumed T2D fraction.
Lower measured risk is not proof of general health; diagnoses and markers are incomplete.
Matches a candidate observation rule, not a clinical diagnosis or transported national stock.
Observation label aligns; complete-case selection, age and temporal transport remain unresolved.
No corresponding engine stock. These people must not be dropped or declared healthy.
Missing interview or measurements remain unknown; no imputation or healthy assignment.

limitations: Public cross-sectional observations cannot identify latent state or transition rates.
Adult, noninstitutionalized survey population and 2017-March 2020 period do not directly initialize every age of the 2024 engine population.
Public age top-coding prevents single-age decomposition in the oldest group; no pediatric interpolation is performed.
Known diagnoses retain precedence within complete cases; incomplete records can remain unclassified despite known diabetes.
Treatment use, control duration, diabetes type, all chronic diseases and confirmed remission are not identified.
PreChronic alternatives and overlapping age domains share observations and must not be summed.
No active model parameter or numerical engine output changes.
complete_case.population: U.S. noninstitutionalized adults in the positive-weight NHANES 2017-March 2020 fasting subsample, excluding known pregnancy within the public age window
complete_case.uncertainty: Existing Taylor logit-t pointwise survey intervals; shared observations, not independent draws. Missingness, diagnostic error, definition and transport uncertainty not identified.
complete_case.unit: fraction of eligible survey weight; unweighted records

observation_partial_mapping.blood_pressure_missingness: Treat the marker as unknown unless all six existing required readings are finite and positive; do not average fewer readings. This coarsening gives conservative bounds.

observation_partial_mapping.population: U.S. noninstitutionalized adults in the eligible NHANES 2017-March 2020 fasting subsample
observation_partial_mapping.uncertainty: Logical compatible-category bounds conditional on recorded rules, with separate Taylor logit-t sampling intervals for each bound endpoint. Not a simultaneous confidence region or an initialization distribution. No missing-at-random assumption or diagnostic-error model.
observation_partial_mapping.unit: fraction of all eligible survey weight; unweighted records

risk.bp_rule: Mean of all three oscillometric readings; either mean at least threshold; one combined BP marker
risk.definition_status: Synthetic operational choices for structural comparison, not clinically validated PreChronic thresholds; individual marker cutoffs are sourced definitions
risk.diagnosis_rule: Yes to known hypertension, high cholesterol, CHF, CHD, angina, MI, stroke or cancer excludes candidate status; unknown responses excluded
risk.glycemic_definition: Inherit registered nhanes_glycemic_prevalence analysis; diabetes then prediabetes take priority
risk.triglyceride_rule: Strictly greater than threshold per cited NHLBI page
risk.waist_rule: Strictly greater than NHLBI 40/35 inches converted at exactly 2.54 cm/inch; not ethnicity-specific

uncertainty: Logical compatible-category bounds conditional on recorded rules, with separate Taylor logit-t sampling intervals for each bound endpoint. Not a simultaneous confidence region or an initialization distribution. No missing-at-random assumption or diagnostic-error model.
unit: fraction of eligible survey weight; unweighted records
